title: An investment never raises the large-gain question, and its check gap is a market move, not a filler (T watch decided, B10)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Free to spend 50,000 (typed); an investment account holds 1,000,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). On Tue 12 Jan the person checks the investment: 1,300,000, a market rise of 30%. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: A rise of 300,000 on an investment is a market move: no question about the figure.
asks.note: Before the decision the 30% rise set off gain_to_ask (final_review_3 watch).

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 50,000 (Free to spend at the opening, typed; the investment's gap is not a filler) = 50,000
